package.name: flex_hardware
package.description: Hardware abstraction layer interfaces (IMU, Encoder, Motor, ODrive, STM32) so the same ROS2 controller stack can drive Gazebo or the real robot without modification. Sim-backed implementations are provided by gz_ros2_control directly today; real_stm32_interface and real_odrive_interface are designed but not implemented (no hardware access — see docs/architecture/deployment_architecture.md). This package currently ships only the abstract interface headers and a contract test.
